#### **2026 SolarWinds World Tour in Toronto**


**October 21st, 12-4:30pm – Washington, DC**


Whether you’re already selling SolarWinds or looking to learn more about the opportunity, World Tour is a great chance to connect with the SolarWinds team, hear directly from industry experts, and discover new ways to grow your business.


Lunch will be served at 12pm and festivities will start at 1pm


**Here’s what you can expect:**


• Learn about the latest SolarWinds innovations, including new AI capabilities


• Explore proven go-to-market strategies to help you grow your SolarWinds practice


• Get the latest updates on the CRN 5-Star recognized SolarWinds Partner Program


• Hear best practices for driving subscription and multi-year business


• Network with fellow partners, customers, and the SolarWinds team
